What our customers are saying
Rated by patients across the country

“So very helpful and sweet attitude. Went out of their way to make sure I had everything that I needed for my CPAP machine. Everyone there was so very nice and had bright smiles. Would recommend this business to anyone with medical supply needs. Beats everyone that I have been to before. Check them out! It is definitely worth your time! Great job everyone!”

“I have been a member of AdaptHealth for several years and their services are highly recommended. They are very respectful, reliable, fast and efficient. Their equipments are of great quality and the staff really cares about their members. My overall experience has been exceptional.”

“My wife is on oxygen supplied by AdaptHealth. She needed a larger unit since she had gone from 2 liter to 4 liter per minute. We went to the doctor for a prescription, then went by and ate lunch. We had barely gotten home (15-minute drive) when the technician called & said he was 15 minutes away. I was surprised & pleased at the fast service. Thank you AdaptHealth for your fast & quality service.”

“The service received was very courteous and helpful. The customer representative also assisted me in making the right choice in obtaining the correct walker for my mother and pair of compression socks for myself. In 2015, I suffered a DVT in my left leg and was told by my primary care physician to start wearing compression socks. I now wear sports and casual compression socks that I purchased from this particular store. I will continue to use this store for all my Mother’s and my health needs.”

Place an order or connect with a Ostomy Specialist

Find quick answers to common questions

AdaptHealth provides a comprehensive selection of Ostomy supplies, including one-piece and two-piece pouch systems, drainable and closed pouches, colOstomy, ileostomy, and urostomy pouches, as well as skin barriers, barrier rings, pastes, powders, deodorants, lubricants, and support belts. Our Ostomy Product Specialists can help you find the right solutions for your needs and lifestyle.

Reordering your Ostomy supplies with AdaptHealth is easy and convenient. Once you’re set up as a patient, you can reorder supplies through your assigned AdaptHealth location, by phone, or through available online reorder options. Our team helps manage refill schedules based on your prescription and insurance guidelines, so you receive supplies on time without unnecessary gaps in care.

Yes. AdaptHealth’s specialty care team includes trained clinicians and product specialists who can help you choose Ostomy supplies that best match your medical needs, lifestyle, and comfort preferences. We work closely with your physician’s prescription and can recommend appropriate pouching systems, skin barriers, and accessories to help improve fit, comfort, and confidence.

Many insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, cover Ostomy supplies when they are medically necessary and prescribed by a physician. Coverage amounts, approved quantities, and patient responsibility vary by plan. AdaptHealth verifies your insurance benefits, explains any out-of-pocket costs upfront, and handles the required documentation to ensure compliant and accurate billing.
